summary: Frontend-only testing for the new SolicitudView (SRV service requests) admin state-update panel and QR-regression. All 6 requested flows pass end-to-end: (1) Wizard creates SRV via /nueva-solicitud → success modal with code SRV-2026-######, (2) 'Ver solicitud' navigates to /solicitud/{codigo}, view shows código, estado 'Solicitado', tracking-bar, and initial historial 'Solicitud creada'. (3) Admin panel visible (isAdmin auto-login) with estado-select (8 states), estado-comentario textarea, and registrar-estado button. (4) Updating to 'Programado' with comment → toast 'Estado actualizado', badge → 'Programado', tracking bar advanced, new historial entry added, and CHANGE PERSISTS after full page reload (localStorage). (5) SRV visible in /mis-solicitudes with 'Servicio' origin; clicking navigates to /solicitud/{codigo}. (6) QR regression: clicking SOL-000013 opens /requests/{id} with its 4-state (NUEVA/EN REVISIÓN/EN PROCESO/FINALIZADA) update panel intact.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warnings: missing DialogTitle and Description/aria-describedby. Not blocking but hurts a11y.

action_items: (Low priority a11y) Add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden wrapper) and aria-describedby/Description to the success modal in NuevaSolicitud.js and any other DialogContent lacking them.
critical_code_review_comments: mockData.generarCodigo starts counter at 122 → first code is always SRV-2026-000123 for every new browser (localStorage). Fine for demo but worth flagging so testers/users aren't confused by repeated codes across devices.
SolicitudView flowIndex falls back to 0 when estado is unknown; consider surfacing an inline warning if estado is not in ESTADOS_FLUJO.
actualizarSolicitud silently returns null when código not found — SolicitudView doesn't handle null on registrar (unlikely path since it's guarded by !s early-return, but worth defensive check).
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral SRV-2026-000123 via wizard in localStorage as part of the test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SRV service requests live entirely in browser localStorage (keys: ot_solicitudes, ot_counter). Counter default 122 → first SRV code is SRV-2026-000123. Auto-login is admin (isAdmin true) so the admin state-update panel renders. shadcn Select needs ~200-300ms after opening before clicking options (force=True). QR reports still use backend /api endpoints and RequestDetail page (/requests/{id}) — unaffected by this change.
